scenario: Plain `emit X` (without `logical`) produces `ttl`-style derived facts per LFAC.3.6. X must be declared `scope ttl`. Pin: an occupancy-enter rule using `emit Occupancy zone: m.zone` to a ttl schema compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` observes neither the ttl-style fact nor the lowering.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope ttl 30_s:
    zone: String

schema Occupancy scope ttl 15_min:
    zone: String

rule occupancy_enter:
    Motion m
->
    emit Occupancy zone: m.zone
